# SYNESIS_E163 — Warning

## Description

Fields from 0 bundles; use fields of one BUNDLE.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: the fields come from more than one BUNDLE: .
  One BUNDLE sets the lines (one line per occurrence); fields outside it are
  context. Fields of two bundles would pair occurrences that do not belong together.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **AlpacaMultipleBundles**: `block`, `bundles`
